# The Future of Local AI

Local AI is rapidly evolving. By running models locally, we preserve privacy, ensure offline availability, and keep inference costs at zero. This essay explores the primary benefits of taking LLMs completely offline.

First, the obvious benefit is privacy. When no data leaves the machine, enterprise secrets and personal manuscripts remain safe.

Second, zero latency for token generation. Without network transit overhead, offline LLMs offer instantaneous streaming generation once loaded into VRAM.
